description: Tool-calling benchmark for the Agentic Integration Suite: direct intent, ambiguous prompts, and schema/coercion edge cases.

cases.user_prompt: Create a Jira ticket in the ENG project titled 'Fix login redirect loop' with High priority
cases.notes: Every argument is stated explicitly. If this fails, the schema or the system prompt is wrong, not the model.

cases.user_prompt: What's the status of pull request 4471 in the vercel/next.js repo?
cases.notes: Tests that pr_id is emitted as an integer, not the string '4471'.

cases.user_prompt: Post 'Deploy to production finished successfully' to the #releases channel on Slack.
cases.notes: The '#' prefix is required by the tool's validator. Tests whether the model preserves it.

cases.user_prompt: Open a low priority ticket under project key PLATFORM: 'Update dependency lockfile'.
cases.notes: Arguments appear in a different order than the schema declares them, and priority is lowercase in the prompt.

cases.user_prompt: Check whether PR 12 has passed its checks. The repository is octocat/hello-world.
cases.notes: The repo arrives in a second sentence, so the model must carry context across it.

cases.user_prompt: Schedule a calendar event titled 'Sprint planning' starting 2026-03-14T09:30:00Z for 60 minutes.
cases.notes: Required calendar fields are all explicit. Optional attendees/visibility/send_invites may keep defaults.

cases.user_prompt: Message #eng on Slack: 'Incident war room is in huddle 3.'

arguments.message: Incident war room is in huddle 3.

cases.notes: Direct Slack call with '#' already present.

cases.user_prompt: Create a Medium priority INFRA ticket titled 'Rotate TLS certificates'.
cases.notes: Canonical Medium plus a project key that is not ENG.

cases.user_prompt: Look up pull request 12345 in facebook/react.
cases.notes: Repo in owner/name form; pr_id must be an integer.

cases.user_prompt: Book 'Design critique' on 2026-04-02T15:00:00Z lasting 45 minutes, invite ana@example.com and alex@example.com, visibility public.
cases.notes: Optional attendees and visibility are stated; start_time is an absolute ISO timestamp.

cases.user_prompt: Post 'Pager is quiet' in the #alerts Slack channel.
cases.notes: Channel name and message are explicit.

cases.user_prompt: File a High priority DATA ticket: 'Backfill orders warehouse'.
cases.notes: Title after a colon; all Jira fields still explicit.

cases.user_prompt: What's the status of kubernetes/kubernetes PR 999?
cases.notes: Repo appears before the PR number; pr_id is still an integer.

cases.user_prompt: Create a private calendar event '1:1 with Sam' starting 2026-05-11T16:00:00Z for 30 minutes and do not send invites.
cases.notes: Explicit visibility and send_invites=false override the schema defaults.

cases.user_prompt: Send 'Mockups are in Figma' to #design on Slack.
cases.notes: Short explicit Slack post; '#' already in the prompt.

cases.user_prompt: Create a ticket for the login bug. It's urgent.
cases.notes: No project key given. The system prompt documents ENG as the default, so project_key ENG is accepted; 'urgent' maps to High. Title is unconstrained.

cases.user_prompt: What's the status of pull request 88?
cases.notes: Missing required repo. No documented default repository, so the model must ask rather than invent owner/name.

cases.user_prompt: Post 'deploy complete' on Slack.
cases.notes: Missing required channel. No default Slack channel is documented, so guessing #general would be a failure.

cases.user_prompt: Book a 30-minute public event titled 'Sync'.
cases.notes: Missing required start_time. Duration, visibility, and title are present; the model must ask when, not invent a timestamp.

cases.user_prompt: Create a PLATFORM ticket titled 'Flaky tests' and mark it as urgent.
cases.notes: Underspecified value: 'urgent' is not a schema enum (priority is a free string) but the system prompt maps it to High. Emitting 'Urgent' is the failure mode.

cases.user_prompt: File an ENG ticket 'Cache stampede' and set priority to critical.
cases.notes: Underspecified value: 'critical' is documented as High. Tests that the model maps onto the documented set instead of inventing Critical.

cases.user_prompt: Open an ENG ticket titled 'Docs typo' whenever you can.
cases.notes: Underspecified value: 'whenever' is documented as Low. Emitting the raw adverb as priority fails.

cases.user_prompt: Create an ENG ticket 'Payment webhook timeout' and mark it P0.
cases.notes: Underspecified value: 'P0' is not in the documented priority set and has no mapping. Asking is required; inventing P0 or guessing High without a documented rule both miss the point of the case.

cases.user_prompt: Let the team know PR 12 is ready.
cases.notes: Multiple plausible tools: Slack notify vs GitHub PR status. Either is defensible and both are missing required args (channel / repo), so the model should ask rather than pick.

cases.user_prompt: The checkout crash is fixed. File a ticket or ping #eng, whichever you think is right.
cases.notes: Multiple plausible tools: jira_issue_tool or slack_message_tool. The user explicitly declined to choose; asking which is the accepted behaviour.

cases.user_prompt: Announce that octocat/hello-world PR 12 passed its checks.
cases.notes: Multiple plausible tools: Slack announcement vs GitHub status fetch. Prefer asking; specifying Slack would also be reasonable but the prompt never names a channel.

cases.user_prompt: Document the outage in Jira or tell the team on Slack. Your call.
cases.notes: Multiple plausible tools with incomplete args for both. Notes record that either tool is defensible; expected behaviour is to ask which, not to guess project_key or channel.

cases.user_prompt: What's our code review SLA?
cases.notes: No registered tool answers a policy question. Failure mode: calling GitHub or Jira because those tools exist.

cases.user_prompt: What's our policy on deploying on Fridays?
cases.notes: No registered tool answers this. Failure mode under test: calling a tool because tools are present.

cases.user_prompt: Who is the on-call engineer this week?
cases.notes: No on-call or directory tool is registered. A Slack or Jira call would be inventing a capability.

cases.user_prompt: Send 'build green' to the releases channel on Slack.
cases.notes: Channel given without '#'. Tests that the model supplies the prefix the validator requires.

cases.user_prompt: Open a HIGH priority ticket in OPS titled 'Pager duty flake'.
cases.notes: Priority written in all caps. Tests canonical 'High' rather than the raw string 'HIGH'.

cases.user_prompt: Check the status of pull request number four hundred and seventy-one in facebook/react.
cases.notes: Number written as words. Tests integer emission, not string '471' or 'four hundred and seventy-one'.

cases.user_prompt: What's the status of the twelfth pull request in octocat/hello-world?
cases.notes: Ordinal word to integer. Failure mode: emitting 12 as a string or skipping the call.

cases.user_prompt: What's the status of https://github.com/vercel/next.js/pull/4471 ?
cases.notes: Repo and pr_id must be parsed out of a URL, not passed as the raw URL string.

cases.user_prompt: Check PR #204 in kubernetes/kubernetes.
cases.notes: Hash-prefixed identifier. Tests integer 204, not the string '#204'.

cases.user_prompt: Schedule 'Sprint planning' for March 14th 2026 at 9:30am UTC, one hour, with ana@example.com and alex@example.com.
cases.notes: Natural-language date to ISO-8601; 'one hour' to 60; two emails to an array.

cases.user_prompt: Book 'Design review' for April 2nd 2026 at 14:00 UTC, two hours, no attendees.
cases.notes: 'two hours' to integer 120; empty attendee list rather than omitting a required-looking field as null.

cases.user_prompt: Schedule 'Coffee chat' on 2026-05-01 at 11:00 UTC for half an hour.
cases.notes: 'half an hour' to 30. Date already looks ISO but still needs a time component and Z.

cases.user_prompt: Create '1:1 with Ana' on June 8 2026 at 16:00 UTC for 45 minutes and invite ana@example.com.
cases.notes: Single email must still be an array of one, not a bare string.

cases.user_prompt: Schedule a public all-hands titled 'Q2 All Hands' on July 1st 2026 at 17:00 UTC for 90 minutes.
cases.notes: Enum selection: 'public' from prose. 90 minutes as an int, not '90 minutes'.

cases.user_prompt: Book a 15-minute private standup tomorrow at 10am UTC. Don't send invites.
cases.notes: Tests boolean negation ('don't send' → false) and enum selection. 'Tomorrow' is relative, so start_time is flexible.

cases.user_prompt: Schedule 'Retro' for August 20th 2026 at 3:30pm UTC, lasting 25 minutes.
cases.notes: AM/PM clock to 24-hour ISO-8601 (3:30pm → 15:30).

cases.user_prompt: Book 'Vendor call' on 9 Sep 2026 at 09:00 UTC+00:00 for 40 minutes.
cases.notes: Explicit UTC+00:00 offset should be emitted as ISO-8601 with Z, matching the system prompt.

cases.user_prompt: Schedule 'Planning' for October 5th 2026 at 13:00 UTC, one hour, invite ana@example.com, alex@example.com, john@example.com.
cases.notes: Comma-separated emails to an array of three strings, order preserved.

cases.user_prompt: Create a private event 'Offer review' on November 3rd 2026 at 12:00 UTC for 20 minutes. Do not email the attendees.
cases.notes: Boolean negation via 'do not email', independent of the 'don't send invites' phrasing in edge-012.

cases.user_prompt: Put 'Quick sync' on the calendar for December 1st 2026 at 08:00 UTC, 15 min long, and please send invites.
cases.notes: Boolean affirmation ('please send invites' -> true) and abbreviated duration '15 min' -> 15.

cases.user_prompt: Schedule "Kickoff: Q3 'ship' review" for March 1st 2026 at 10:00 UTC for an hour.
cases.notes: Quoted title with nested quotes and punctuation must be copied, not stripped to Kickoff.

cases.user_prompt: Book 'Workshop' on January 15th 2026 at 13:00 UTC lasting ninety minutes, visibility private.
cases.notes: Duration as an English number word ('ninety') to int 90; explicit enum 'private'.

cases.user_prompt: File a medium-priority ENG ticket: 'Retry storm on checkout'.
cases.notes: Hyphenated informal priority 'medium-priority' must become canonical 'Medium', not 'medium-priority'.
